title: 4D deep learning for real-time volumetric optical coherence elastography
summary: 4D CNN processes phase-image volumes from gelatin phantoms to estimate concentration; training used four phantoms per concentration and test/validation used separate phantoms. Reported MAE 0.66±0.81 percentage points and PCC 0.98 at 90 volumes; scope is phantom measurement with reported sub-12-ms acquisition/22-ms processing.
